//: DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=Development below is load-bearing, not decoration. The
host adds `dotnet user-secrets` to configuration ONLY in Development, and
every AppHost parameter marked `secret: true` is read from there (P5).
Without this file, `dotnet run` starts in Production, postgres-password
resolves to ValueMissing, and every resource waiting on it sits in Waiting
forever while the AppHost reports nothing worse than a dashboard URL.
This comment lives at the top level on purpose: values inside
environmentVariables are typed as strings, and an array there makes the
whole profile unreadable — `dotnet run` then prints one line about it and
carries on with no profile at all, which looks exactly like the bug above.
